method: Five independent actual image_gen calls, one per final image; opaque backgrounds. Existing A/B and five representative screens inspected for style only; no image references submitted. No rejected attempts or image editing.

Midground a broad sunny window, behind it and beside it tidy shelves with clear glass vases of water, flowers and potted plants. Big quiet areas of thin wrapping paper and glowing water droplets express precise calm work. Flowers include soft cream daisies, muted rust blossoms and green foliage. No price tags, packaging writing or shop names. Make bouquet-wrapping hands and window unmistakable.
